We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. We have no SMILES given. We need to get IR spectra maybe to see carbonyl stretch. Or carbon NMR? But easiest is to get IR spectra which shows C=O stretch around 1700 cm-1. However we need count. Could also get carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). But we need number of carbonyl groups.

We need the compound at hand. Not given. Possibly the system has a default sample? The tools operate on "sample at hand". So we can just call ir_spectra to get IR. Then count carbonyl peaks. Let's do that.
